name: bigarrow (big-arrow-on-the-screen)
description: Lets coding agents draw arrows, boxes, and labels over any macOS window to show the human what to click, with copy buttons and spoken signs, via a Swift CLI and agent skill.

skills.name: Point at UI Elements
skills.description: Draws an arrow and sign at an element by label, a coordinate, a window, or the mouse, then removes it.

skills.name: Copy Buttons
skills.description: Turns {{value}} in a sign into a copy button the human can click to paste.

skills.name: Spoken Signs
skills.description: Reads the sign aloud with --say to call the human back to the screen.

skills.name: PNG Rendering
skills.description: Renders the overlay straight to a PNG with --png for demos and docs.

skills.name: Claude Code and Codex Skill
skills.description: Installs a skill that teaches agents when and how to point and to stop once the human acts.
